description: A factor regressor f declared d, b, a, c (not alphabetical): treatment coding against d, coefficients (Intercept), x, fb, fa, fc.
r_call: partykit::lmtree(formula = y_gauss ~ x + f | z1 + z2, data = sim_formula_factor, alpha = 0.05, bonferroni = TRUE, minsize = NULL, maxdepth = Inf, mtry = Inf, trim = 0.1, breakties = FALSE, parm = NULL, dfsplit = TRUE, prune = NULL, restart = TRUE, verbose = FALSE, caseweights = TRUE, ytype = "vector", xtype = "matrix", terminal = c("estfun", "object"), inner = c("estfun", "object"), model = TRUE, numsplit = "left", catsplit = "binary", vcov = "opg", ordinal = "chisq", nrep = 10000, applyfun = NULL, cores = NULL)

na_action.note: removed_rows are 0-based indices into the data CSV, from the na.action attribute of the model frame; every other row index in this file refers to the remaining rows

predict.note: New rows: the regressors, response and weights of training row regressor_rows[i], the partitioning variables of training row partitioning_rows[i] (0-based indices into the data CSV), drawn from the rows the tree used that avoid excluded_levels. Factor columns keep the data's declared levels; levels_present lists the levels that occur. Every row is routed deterministically.
